span.p:
Supervisor force-killed
(Electron · CI runner · thin shim)
SIGKILL — no chance to forward signal

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Without --no-orphans:
Bun reparented to launchd/init
runs forever + everything it spawned

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
--no-orphans
opt-in: auto-exit when parent dies
+ recursively SIGKILL descendants

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
env var
BUN_FEATURE_FLAG_NO_ORPHANS=1
bun run my-script

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
flag auto-inherited
by nested Bun processes
enable once at top level

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
prctl PR_SET_PDEATHSIG SIGKILL
kernel-delivered · no polling · no thread

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
children spawned from main thread
inherit PDEATHSIG by default
→ non-Bun descendants covered

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EVFILT_PROC / NOTE_EXIT watch
on existing event loop kqueue
no dedicated thread · no extra fd
